# Introduction

This script derives the estimate of the treatment effect of Dexamethasone compared
to Placebo on the change-from-baseline MADRS-10 total score at day 7 using the 
treatment policy estimand (the primary analysis of the primary endpoint for the 
primary estimand) based on the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP), version 1.0. The 
script was developed independently as part of the parallel programming quality 
control process.

The program relies on `data.table` for data management, `mmrm` for fitting the 
mixed model for repeated measurements, and `emmeans` for obtaining estimates 
adjusted to the full analysis set (FAS). R version and package versions are 
documented in the `sessionInfo()` in the Appendix.

The target output format follows the specifications in
*parallel_programming_output_target.xlsx* which is located in the current
folder.
Paths to input data (raw trial data exported from REDCap and treatment
allocation file) and output file are specified via the parameters
`raw_trial_data_path`, `treatment_data_path` and `output_path` in the YAML
header.

# Setup

Load libraries
```{r}
library(data.table)
library(mmrm)
library(emmeans)
```

# Data preparation

Load the raw trial data and treatment allocation data
```{r}
# Raw data exported from REDcap
raw_dt <- fread(params$raw_trial_data_path)
# Treatment allocation file
trt_dt <- readRDS(params$treatment_data_path)
```

Select variables and observations
```{r}
# IDs of randomized participants
randomized_ids <- raw_dt[!is.na(rand_id), .(rec_id, rand_id)]

# Relevant columns to the analysis
cols_to_keep <- c(
  "rec_id", "rand_id", "redcap_event_name", "redcap_repeat_instance", 
  "besoeg_dato", "madrs10_total_dag0", "madrs_total_dag4",
  "madrs10_total_dag7", "madrs_total_dag14", "madrs10_total_dag28",
  "forsoegsmedicin_startdato"
  )

# Relevant visit events
visit_events <- c(
  "dag_0_arm_1", "dag_4_arm_1", "dag_7_arm_1", 
  "dag_14_arm_1", "dag_28_arm_1"
  )

# Keep only relevant data
dt <- raw_dt[rec_id %in% randomized_ids$rec_id &
               redcap_event_name %in% visit_events, 
             ..cols_to_keep]
```

## Derive analysis variables

Determine Day 0 and visit windows
```{r}
# Format visit variable
dt[, c_visit := gsub("_arm_1|_", "", redcap_event_name)]
dt[, n_visit := as.numeric(gsub("_arm_1|dag_", "", redcap_event_name))]

# Compute day 0 as the day prior to medication start
dt[, d_d0 := as.Date(forsoegsmedicin_startdato) -1]
# Check that no participants have multiple day 0's
stopifnot(
  nrow(dt[!is.na(d_d0), .N, c("rec_id","d_d0")][N>1]) == 0
  )
# Add the day 0 date to all rows for each participant
dt[, d_d0 := d_d0[!is.na(d_d0)], by = rec_id]

# Add target date for each visit
dt[, d_target := d_d0 + n_visit]

# Add visit windows
# Day 4, 7, 14: +/- 2 days
dt[c_visit %in% c("dag4","dag7","dag14"), c("d_lvw", "d_uvw") := list(d_target -2, d_target + 2)]
# Day 28: +/- 28 days
dt[c_visit == "dag28", c("d_lvw", "d_uvw") := list(d_target - 4, d_target + 4)]

# Compute in window status for all outcome measurements
dt[, in_window := 1*(besoeg_dato >= d_lvw & besoeg_dato <= d_uvw)]
```

Derive MADRS-10 total score for all visits
```{r}
# Collect MADRS-10 total scores in one column
# Check that no row have more than one outcome measurement
stopifnot(
  all(rowSums(!is.na(dt[, c("madrs10_total_dag0", "madrs_total_dag4", "madrs10_total_dag7",
                            "madrs_total_dag14", "madrs10_total_dag28")])) %in% c(0, 1))
  )
dt[, madrs := fcoalesce(madrs10_total_dag0, madrs_total_dag4, madrs10_total_dag7,
                          madrs_total_dag14, madrs10_total_dag28)]

# Replace outcome value with NA if recorded outside the visit window
dt[c_visit != "dag0" & in_window == 0, madrs := NA]

# Choose last recorded observation in window for all visits
setorder(dt, rec_id, n_visit, -in_window, -redcap_repeat_instance)
dt2 <- dt[!is.na(madrs), .SD[1], .(rec_id, c_visit)]

# Check that all individuals have a madrs score on day 0
stopifnot(
  nrow(dt2[!is.na(madrs) & c_visit == "dag0", .SD[1], rec_id]) == 
    dt[!is.na(rand_id), uniqueN(rand_id)]
  )

# Augment data such that all randomized participants have one row per visit
id_x_visit <- expand.grid(rec_id = unique(dt2$rec_id), 
                          c_visit = unique(dt2$c_visit))
dt3 <- merge(dt2, id_x_visit, all.y = TRUE)
```

Derive baseline MADRS-10 total score and change-from-baseline scores
```{r}
# Add baseline  score to all rows
dt3[, madrs_d0 := madrs[c_visit == "dag0"], rec_id]
# Compute change from baseline scores
dt3[, chgbl := madrs - madrs_d0]
```

Derive FAS population flag and restrict data to day 4 and 7 visits
```{r}
# Compute FAS membership
dt3[, i_FAS := 1*(sum(in_window[c_visit != "dag0"] * madrs[c_visit != "dag0"], na.rm = TRUE) > 0), by = rec_id]

# Keep only day 4 and 7 rows from individuals in FAS
dt4 <- dt3[i_FAS == 1 & c_visit %in% c("dag4", "dag7"), .(rec_id, chgbl, madrs_d0, c_visit, i_FAS)]
```

Add treatment variable
```{r}
adat <- merge(dt4, trt_dt, by.x = "rec_id", by.y = "ID")
```

Convert variables to factors as required by mmrm()
```{r}
# Convert IDs to factor
adat[, rec_id := factor(rec_id)]

# Drop unused levels of c_visit, such that only day 4 and 7 remain
adat[, c_visit := droplevels(c_visit)]

# Convert treatment to factor with Placebo as reference
adat[, trt := factor(trt)]
adat[, trt := relevel(trt, ref = grep("^[Pp]lacebo", levels(trt), value = TRUE))]
```

# Statistical analysis

Fit MMRM model with change-from-baseline MADRS-10 total score
```{r}
fit <- mmrm(formula = chgbl ~ (madrs_d0 + trt) * c_visit + us(c_visit | rec_id), 
            data = adat,
            reml = TRUE,
            method = "Satterthwaite")
summary(fit)
```

Compute estimated marginal means and treatment effect adjusted to the FAS population
```{r}
# Obtain estimated means 
(emm_trt <- emmeans(fit, ~ trt | c_visit, data = adat))

# Treatment contrast (Dexamethasone - Placebo) 
(trt_contrast <- contrast(emm_trt, method = "revpairwise", by = "c_visit", infer =TRUE))
```

# Output preparation

Count number of participants contributing to the analysis, in FAS and with missing
outcome values on day 7 per treatment arm
```{r}
# FAS, N, Miss
n_summary <- adat[, .(Visit = "Day 7",
                   FAS = uniqueN(rec_id),
                   N = uniqueN(rec_id[!is.na(chgbl)]),
                   Miss = sum(is.na(chgbl[c_visit == "dag7"]))), trt]
```

Extract and format estimated marginal means for day 7
```{r}
# Extract results related to Day 7 and keep only relevant columns
emm_day7 <- as.data.table(subset(emm_trt, c_visit == "dag7"))
emm_out <- emm_day7[, .(trt, emmean, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL)]

# Format estimated mean and 95% CI as a character string
emm_out[, `Est. Mean (95% CI)` := sprintf("%.1f (%.1f; %.1f)", emmean, lower.CL, upper.CL)]

# Rename columns
setnames(
  emm_out,
  c("SE", "lower.CL", "upper.CL"), 
  c("em_se", "em_lwr", "em_upr")
  )

# Preview output
emm_out
```

Extract and format estimated treatment effect for day 7
```{r}
# Extract treatment effect on day 7
contrast_day7 <- as.data.table(subset(trt_contrast, c_visit == "dag7"))

# Format effect and 95% CI as character string
contrast_day7[, `Effect (95% CI)` := sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL)]

# Add a dummy treatment variable such that the treatment effect row can be merged 
# correctly under the Dexmethasone group in the output table
contrast_day7[, trt := factor(grep("^[Dd]exameth", levels(trt_dt$trt), value = TRUE), levels = levels(trt_dt$trt))]

# Keep only relevant columns
contrast_out <- contrast_day7[, .(trt, estimate, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL, `Effect (95% CI)`, p.value)]

contrast_out
# Format p-value as character string
contrast_out[, `p-value` := ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                                   "<0.001", 
                                   sprintf("%.3f", p.value))]

# Rename columns
setnames(
  contrast_out, 
  c("estimate", "SE", "lower.CL", "upper.CL", "p.value"), 
  c("effect", "eff_se", "eff_lwr", "eff_upr", "p_val")
  )

# Preview output
contrast_out
```

Create output table
```{r}
# Merge n_summary, emm_out and contrast_out
final_output <- merge(merge(n_summary, emm_out), contrast_out, all.x = TRUE)

# Rename treatment variable
setnames(final_output, "trt", "Treatment")

# Inspect classes
str(final_output)
class(final_output)
```

Save output to the path specified by the output_path parameter
```{r}
saveRDS(final_output, params$output_path)
```
